classification.difficultyReason: Extract usable graph coordinates and substitute into the supplied forms; the hardest part requires two equations to determine both coefficient and vertical shift.

content.prompt: Find the equation of the following functions, given it is of the stated form:

spec.description: Square grid, double-ended axes, selected integer labels and one increasing logarithmic curve. No marked points.
spec.mathematics: y=log_3(x); x-window [-2,10], y-window [-6,6]. Grid steps 1. Curve passes through (1,0), (3,1), (9,2).
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied curve is a student-visible question given. Its equation and read-off coordinates are not printed on the graph.

answer.short:
$y=\log_3 x$.

Substitute a labelled point into the given form, then convert to exponential form to find the base.
answer.worked:
Using $(3,1)$:
$$\begin{align*}1&=\log_k 3\end{align*}$$
Exponentiate both sides base $k$.
$$\begin{align*}k^1&=3\\k&=3\\y&=\log_3 x\end{align*}$$

spec.description: Square plotting area with one-unit minor grid and stronger two-unit lines, double-ended axes and an increasing logarithmic curve.
spec.mathematics: y=4 log_2(x); x-window [-2,10], y-window [-4,14]. Curve passes through (1,0), (2,4), (4,8), (8,12).
spec.answerVisibility: Curve and axis labels are student-visible givens. No coordinate annotations or equation label are added.

spec.description: Approximately square plotting area with unequal numeric axis scales, rectangular lattice and one increasing logarithmic curve.
spec.mathematics: y=log_4(x)+3; x-window [-8,24], y-window [-3,8]. Grid steps: x=2, y=1. Curve passes through (4,4), (16,5); x-intercept 1/64 is unlabelled.
spec.answerVisibility: The supplied graph is visible in the question. Equation, coordinates and intercept value remain unprinted.

spec.description: Approximately square plotting area with an increasing logarithmic curve and black filled points A and B. Labels sit to the right of their markers, A slightly below.
spec.mathematics: y=4 log_2(x)+3; x-window [-2,10], y-window [-4,18]. Unit grid with stronger horizontal lines at even y-values. A=(4,11), B=(8,15).
spec.answerVisibility: Curve, filled markers and letters A and B are student-visible. Coordinate pairs and the fitted equation are answer content only.

answer.short:
$y=4\log_2 x+3$.

Substitute both labelled points, then subtract the resulting equations to find the coefficient and intercept.
answer.worked:
From the graph, $A=(4,11)$ and $B=(8,15)$.

Using $A$:
$$\begin{align*}11&=k\log_2 4+c\\11&=2k+c\end{align*}$$
Using $B$:
$$\begin{align*}15&=k\log_2 8+c\\15&=3k+c\end{align*}$$
Subtract the first simplified equation from the second.
$$\begin{align*}15-11&=(3k+c)-(2k+c)\\4&=k\\k&=4\end{align*}$$
Substitute $k=4$:
$$\begin{align*}11&=2(4)+c\\c&=3\\y&=4\log_2 x+3\end{align*}$$
